nom: Curology Clear Pimple Patches for Face

segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive skin reports cheaper bulk patches broke her out badly and a competing brand hurt to remove, while these patches cleared a blemish within three days without pain and helped with redness.

concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report the patches calm redness and inflammation around a blemish, often visibly reduced by the next morning; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the patches draw out pus or gunk overnight and visibly shrink blemishes by morning, working best once a pimple has already come to a head; one reviewer reports they did not absorb as well as other brands and her pimples kept refilling, and two others note the patches cannot drain a deep, undeveloped or closed pimple.

aspects.libelle: Thin and nearly invisible on skin
Box or package frequently arrives damaged, opened or missing patches
More expensive than generic drugstore patches
Sturdy adhesion, stays on overnight through sleep
Can curl up and become unusable if not resealed in its sleeve

extraits.titre: They’re ok, theres better options for cheaper
extraits.texte: I’ve tried several types of pimple patches and these aren’t the worse, but there’s others that I prefer more. These do not seem to absorb gunk as well as the others, my pimples have been refilling which usually never happens. I also have to use several of these on one pimple. Im going back to PanOxyl.

Product It’s self is great big fan of the patches, but the box was damaged like someone stomped on it. At least patches were wrapped in baggies if not, it would’ve compromised the product. The product itself is not what it used to be although the application blends onto the skin. The pimple patch itself isn’t as effective almost like it was stored in humid conditions.

extraits.titre: This Product Does Exactky What It Claims!!
extraits.texte: I purchased this as a stocking stuffer for my 20 year old daughter. She is a junior in college and was home for the holidays. I noticed her breakouts had increased and she said she’s starting to get whiteheads/pimples on her chin area and t zone. I saw this package and had heard very good things about this brand from my son who ordered a trial supply for his acne. (19 yo). He had great success with it, so I thought I would get the patches for my daughter to try when she has the occasional breakout. To add, my daughter loves the idea of the patches. She has tried several brands and most seem to help somewhat, but none do what this brand did. She applied a pimple patch to a larger, whitehead pimple. This is much better than squeezing it and risking getting a scar for life! She did this after a shower one night before bed. When she woke up the next morning she was shocked that the pimple patch completely removed all of the whitehead/pus from the pimple, reduced redness completely and her face looked 1000 times better. She was so excited to tell me all about it! It truly was amazing and def a product we will continue to purchase. 10/10 recommend! This brand was created by dermatologist. Their products actually work and the patches did exactly what they promised to do! I highly recommend the patches to anyone that struggles with whiteheads or acne. extraits.titre: Most absorbent patch I have tried
extraits.texte: These seem like they absorb more gunk than some other brands I have tried. They seem slightly thinner and more prone to sticking to themselves, which makes them a little more difficult to apply, but they work well. They adhere well, are inconspicuous on my skin and not hard to remove. I have bought brands that include multiple sizes of patch in each box, but have not found the smaller sized ones to be as useful, personally. These were a good unit price. I don’t love that the sheets are enclosed in plastic/foil pouches and that the sheets are plastic. Not sure about the biodegradability of the patches themselves, either, so I try to use them sparingly. Nothing else out there drains the yucky goop out of a swollen pimple as effectively and quickly, though. In order to work they do need to be making direct contact with the goop. These can’t drain a closed papule, but if you can bring it to a head with some benzoyl peroxide cream or a gentle warm compress first that can help. Once the patches have been saturated with exudate it is advisable to change them promptly so they aren’t exerting pressure that could contribute to scarring.

Okay! I already use Curology products. I had terrible hormonal acne in my late 20’s and their products cleared me up for the most part! Due to their prices being higher than I’d like I never got these patches before. I usually use the Walmart brand for $3 and call it a day. Well I decided to purchase a random bundle of patches on Amazon for $10 that came with like 300 patches. They broke me out very bad. I have sensitive skin and I knew it was a gamble. Then I purchased Neutrogena patches and they stuck to my skin so bad I thought they would peel my skin off when I took them off. They didn't work though. So I ordered these curology patches and within 3 day it’s already better! They stick perfectly without hurting when I remove them. They also aren’t super shiny so I can wear them and not feel like it’s extremely noticeable. They help with redness as well. I will absolutely keep these in stock.

I recommend these Curology Emergency Spot Pimple Patches to everyone! They actually work. Whenever I have a pimple that's come to a head, I put one on before bed, and by the next morning it has extracted a lot of the buildup and looks much smaller. One thing to keep in mind is that these don't have micro-needles, so they're not the best option for deep, stubborn pimples that haven't developed yet. They work best on pimples that are already a little developed. Overall, these patches have been lifesavers for me. They're easy to use, stay on well overnight, and make a noticeable difference by morning. I'll definitely keep buying them.

extraits.titre: A lifesaver for hiding and calming blemishes!
extraits.texte: These patches have been an absolute lifesaver for me when dealing with stubborn blemishes! They are easy to apply and help calm down the redness after a spot comes to a head, effectively hiding imperfections. Compared to other patches I have used, these are thicker but still remain relatively invisible. A helpful tip I discovered is to apply them with dry hands to dry skin to ensure they adhere well. I have worn these patches overnight and found them effective for calming redness and irritation. I highly recommend adding these to your skincare toolkit!
